content:
The triples are equal exactly when none of the floor values changes, i.e. when
\[
n\equiv 0 \pmod 2,\quad n\not\equiv 2 \pmod 3,\quad n\not\equiv 4 \pmod 5.
\]

Count such \(n\le 600\):
- Even numbers: \(300\).
- Exclude even numbers with \(n\equiv 2\pmod 3\): \(100\), leaving \(200\).
- Among these, exclude those with \(n\equiv 4\pmod 5\). The bad residues mod \(30\) are \(4,24\), giving \(2\cdot 20=40\).

So the number with equal triples is
\[
200-40=160.
\]
Thus the number with distinct triples is
\[
600-160=440.
\]

\[
\boxed{440}
\]
